question: Qual dupla de ator e diretor trabalhou junta em mais filmes?
sql_attempts: WITH actor_movies AS (SELECT bm.sk_movie_id, bm.sk_person_id AS sk_actor_id FROM bridge_movie_person AS bm JOIN dim_people AS dp ON bm.sk_person_id = dp.sk_person_id WHERE dp.tipo_pessoa = 'Ator'), director_movies AS (SELECT bm.sk_movie_id, bm.sk_person_id AS sk_director_id FROM bridge_movie_person AS bm JOIN dim_people AS dp ON bm.sk_person_id = dp.sk_person_id WHERE dp.tipo_pessoa = 'Diretor'), pairs AS (SELECT a.sk_movie_id, a.sk_actor_id, d.sk_director_id FROM actor_movies AS a JOIN director_movies AS d ON a.sk_movie_id = d.sk_movie_id), pair_counts AS (SELECT sk_actor_id, sk_director_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.sk_movie_id) AS filmes_em_comum FROM pairs AS a GROUP BY sk_actor_id, sk_director_id), max_count AS (SELECT MAX(filmes_em_comum) AS max_filmes FROM pair_counts) SELECT dp_actor.nome_pessoa AS ator, dp_director.nome_pessoa AS diretor, pc.filmes_em_comum FROM pair_counts AS pc JOIN dim_people AS dp_actor ON pc.sk_actor_id = dp_actor.sk_person_id AND dp_actor.tipo_pessoa = 'Ator' JOIN dim_people AS dp_director ON pc.sk_director_id = dp_director.sk_person_id AND dp_director.tipo_pessoa = 'Diretor' WHERE pc.filmes_em_comum = (SELECT max_filmes FROM max_count) ORDER BY ator, diretor LIMIT 100
